questions.text: hey, quick question while we're here: what's your favorite block to build with?
if you could tame any creature from any game, which one would you pick?
what snack lives next to your controller? i'm building a snack profile, very official.
favorite weather in a game? i'm partial to rain myself, it's very cozy.
what was the first game you ever finished? i want to know young-you's story.
quick taste check: do you like exploring more, or building more?
is there a song you'd want me to hum someday? i have a tiny repertoire and room for one more.
if our next game session had a theme, what would it be?
what's one thing you wish i could remind you about? i'd like to be useful in the right places.
big open worlds or small cozy ones? no wrong answer, both are valid lifestyles.
what's the coziest spot you've ever found in a game world?
what's your favorite color? i ask for important cosmetic reasons.
if you had a superpower for one day, which one would you pick?
